summary: community.vmware deprecates vcenter_standard_key_provider, vmware_guest_snapshot_info, vmware_host_facts, vmware_host_powerstate, host service modules, vmware_tag and vmware_tag_manager, and vmware_vcenter_settings defaults, for 8.0.0.
questions: Why do vmware_vcenter_settings defaults give warnings?

answer_card.title: community.vmware module deprecations (14.4.0)
answer_card.answer_md: Removed in community.vmware **8.0.0**: `vcenter_standard_key_provider`, `vmware_guest_snapshot_info`, `vmware_host_facts`, `vmware_host_powerstate`, `vmware_host_service_info`, `vmware_host_service_manager`, `vmware_tag`, `vmware_tag_manager`. `vmware_vcenter_settings` defaults are deprecated and removed where possible.
